questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. It only takes a few minutes and helps you avoid dangerous problems before you ride.

questions.question: When riding behind a car, where should you position your motorcycle?

options.text: In any part of the lane.
In the part of the lane closest to the shoulder.
In the part of the lane where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
As close to the car as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the part of the lane where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride where the car driver can see you in their rearview mirror. This is usually the center of the lane. Drivers check their rearview mirrors more often than side mirrors, so this position makes it more likely they will see you.

questions.question: Which item is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Safe motorcycle riders wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves.

questions.question: What helps you maintain control when turning your motorcycle?

options.text: Speed up before entering the turn.
Look ahead through the turn to plan your path.
Stop completely before entering the turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead through the turn to plan your path.
questions.explanation: To stay in control through a turn, look ahead through the turn by turning only your head. Slow down before turning and lean your motorcycle in the right direction.

questions.question: Which item is NOT considered protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding. Good protective gear includes sturdy pants and jackets that cover your arms and legs, boots or heavy shoes that cover your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: When braking, which brakes should you use?

options.text: Either brake, but never both at the same time.

questions.explanation: Always use both brakes at the same time when stopping. Using both brakes together is the most effective way to stop.

questions.question: What should you look for when choosing a helmet for the most protection?

options.text: It has been in a previous crash.

questions.explanation: Buy a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards for the best protection. The helmet should fit snugly all the way around.

questions.question: What is the best gear to wear when riding?

options.text: Any gear that helps protect you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any gear that helps protect you.
questions.explanation: Wear gear that protects you while riding. Good choices include a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, and protective clothing.

questions.question: If you wait one hour for each alcoholic drink before riding, what is true?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
Some effects of drinking may still affect you.
You will be okay as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Some effects of drinking may still affect you.
questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink of alcohol per hour. However, even if you drink only one drink per hour, some alcohol can build up in your body. Your ability and judgment can still be impaired.

questions.question: Which material provides the most protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the best protection when riding.

questions.question: Which of the following should you NOT check before getting on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check tire tread and air pressure, oil and fluid levels, lights, and signals.

questions.question: When carrying a passenger on a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Prepare and adjust your motorcycle for the passenger.
Ride the same way as when alone.
Teach the passenger after you start riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Prepare and adjust your motorcycle for the passenger.
questions.explanation: Your motorcycle must be equipped for passengers. It needs a separate seat, footrests for the passenger, and proper tire pressure and suspension for the extra weight.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT protective clothing for motorcycle riding?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets, long denim pants, and full-fingered gloves protect you in a crash. Wear lace-up boots, high-top boots, or heavy shoes with ankle support instead of athletic shoes.

questions.question: What is the main active ingredient in marijuana?
questions.explanation: The main active ingredient in marijuana is tetrahydrocannabinol, or THC.

questions.question: If a tire goes flat while you are riding, you should:

options.text: Gently brake on the tire that is not flat.
Speed up to exit the road quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently brake on the tire that is not flat.
questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat, release the throttle and go straight as you slow down. If you must brake, gently apply the brake on the tire that is not flat.

questions.question: When riding, you should:

options.text: Always look ahead and watch for dangers.
Watch your controls and speedometer instead of the road.
Not worry about hazards because there are very few on the road.
Look ahead but ignore any hazards you see.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always look ahead and watch for dangers.
questions.explanation: Look well ahead to see potential hazards early. This gives you time to react safely before you reach them.

questions.question: How should you handle a tailgater?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make hand gestures.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to change lanes and let them pass. Speeding up will only make them tailgate at higher speeds, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Is usually too warm to wear while riding.
Should not be worn while riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved jacket, ideally leather, for protection. In warm weather, leather jackets can help prevent dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool in hot weather.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet must have all of the following, except:

options.text: An outer shell that resists impact.
An inner layer that absorbs impact.

questions.explanation: A DOT-approved helmet must have an impact-resistant outer shell, an impact-absorbing inner liner, a comfort liner, and a chin strap system.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black lettering?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions or hazards.

questions.question: How should you check tire pressure?

options.text: Compare it to another tire's height.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check tire pressure before every ride. A tire that is not fully inflated may still look normal, so you cannot rely on your eyes alone.

questions.question: Which surface provides good traction?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces can reduce tire traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings are more dangerous than dry pavement for motorcyclists.

questions.question: What type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that makes you and your motorcycle visible to other drivers. Bright, reflective clothing makes it easier for others to see you.

questions.question: Which hand controls the accelerator?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is on the right handgrip and is controlled with your right hand.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.
Use your horn and make hand gestures.
Speed up to increase the distance between you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Change lanes when possible and allow the tailgater to pass. Speeding up will not help—the driver will likely tailgate you at a higher speed, which is more dangerous.
